name: zsnd_stream_request_state_wait_repeat_delay
description: zSndStreamRequest::StateWaitRepeatDelay waits for group delayRepeatSec before selecting a fresh weighted entry and returning to play state.
known_limits: tier S verification remains open for the stream request state-machine cluster.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a4fd0 validates elapsed-time accumulation, x87 comparison against group->delayRepeatSec, elapsed reset, SelectWeightedEntry call, current-entry storage, and state 1 versus state 4 transition.
The native smoke verifies the request remains in repeat delay before the threshold and returns to play state with a selected group entry when the threshold is reached.
